issue.description: The draft/specification and extracted candidates do not capture the email-requested color-coded visual indicators for the capacity overview (green/yellow/red). This visualization was explicitly requested in DOC-002 and is a concrete UI requirement that affects overview readability and quick decision-making.
issue.suggested_fix: Add a functional requirement (or candidate) that the system's capacity overview provide color-coded status indicators as requested in the source (quote provided). Because the source does not define numeric thresholds, add an associated open question (or require administrator-configurable thresholds) to capture how colors map to capacity values so implementers are not forced to invent threshold values.

reason: Capacity overview color-coding was requested in DOC-002/CAND-00227 and is a concrete UI requirement not captured in the draft; require configurable thresholds or admin-configurable mapping.

issue.description: Independent review discovered CAND-00227: The capacity overview should include color-coded status indicators (e.g., green/yellow/red) to show under-capacity, approaching capacity, and at/over-capacity states.
issue.suggested_fix: Integrate this new grounded candidate, merging only if semantically equivalent.

reason: CAND-00227 (color-coded capacity indicators) is a grounded candidate called out by reviewers and should be integrated rather than omitted.

issue.description: CAND-00026 (Transfer History Tracking) is present but omits audit/logging detail requested in the source (explicit 'logging - track all transfers for audit purposes'). The existing candidate records the need to track transfer history but does not specify required audit attributes (who performed the transfer, timestamp, origin and destination locations, reason/notes, or an immutable audit trail).
issue.suggested_fix: Expand CAND-00026 to require an auditable transfer log entry for every batch transfer including: operator identifier, timestamp, items affected (identifiers), source location, destination location, transfer method (manual/scheduled/automatic), optional reason or event trigger, and support for querying/producing reports from that log.

reason: Transfer-history logging in CAND-00026 lacks explicit audit attributes requested in sources (who/timestamp/source/dest/reason); the requirement should mandate an auditable transfer log with those fields.

issue.description: CAND-00027 (Auto-Revert Mechanism) captures time-based and event-based reversion in a general way but omits two substantive implementation details explicitly requested in the source: (a) the scheduling mechanism (the source asks for a 'scheduled task' that performs checks) and (b) precedence/interaction rules (examples in the source: 'revert after X days' unless 'checked out at destination', or revert when status changes to 'sold').
issue.suggested_fix: Clarify CAND-00027 to require: (1) a configurable scheduled task (with configurable frequency) that evaluates transfer records and applies time-based reversion; (2) configurable event triggers (status-change triggers such as 'sold', 'checked out at destination') that can override or cancel scheduled reversion; and (3) explicit precedence/override rules (for example: event-based 'checked out at destination' cancels scheduled reversion unless explicitly configured otherwise).

reason: Auto-revert candidate (CAND-00027) omits the scheduled-task implementation detail and explicit precedence/override rules described in the sources; these are required to avoid ambiguous behavior.

issue.description: CAND-00023 (Preview Before Changes) requires a preview but does not preserve the source's requested UI detail: a preview that summarizes the operation (for example, 'If you run this now, 25 items will be moved from Dalton-Whitman to Mobile Library Unit 3. Confirm?').
issue.suggested_fix: Amend CAND-00023 to require the preview to include a clear summary with counts and scope (number of items, source(s), destination(s), scheduled time if any) and require an explicit confirmation action before applying changes.

reason: Preview requirement (CAND-00023) should require a clear operation summary (counts, sources, destination, scheduled time) and explicit confirmation per the source example.

issue.description: CAND-00019 (Manual Selection of Titles) states manual selection from query results is required but omits UI-level selection behaviors requested in the source (e.g., checkbox selection, support for selecting a subset of results from a larger query, select-all across pages).
issue.suggested_fix: Extend CAND-00019 to require multi-select UI controls (checkboxes), select-all and clear-selection actions, support for paged result selection with persistent selection across pages, and bulk-selection by range or imported barcode list.

reason: Manual-selection candidate (CAND-00019) omits UI selection behaviors requested by stakeholders (checkboxes, persistent multi-page selection, select-all); add these concrete UI semantics.

issue.description: CAND-00022 (Revert Items to Original Location) captures revert after time and/or based on other criteria but omits the concrete event examples from the source (for example, revert when status changes to 'sold' at a book sale, revert when item is or is not checked out at destination).
issue.suggested_fix: Clarify CAND-00022 to require configurable event-trigger definitions (status-change triggers such as 'sold', checkout events at destination, manual event markers) and the ability to attach those triggers to saved transfer operations so reversion can be conditional on specific events.

reason: Revert-to-original candidate (CAND-00022) must include configurable event triggers (e.g., sold, checked out at destination) as described by stakeholders; current wording is too vague.

issue.description: Independent review discovered CAND-00229: An auto-revert implementation detail: a scheduled task/process that periodically checks transferred items and performs reversion based on elapsed time or configured event/status criteria.

reason: Auto-revert scheduled-task detail (CAND-00229) is an implementation-level but required behavior described by sources and should be preserved.

issue.description: The draft candidate for 'Missing and Damaged Items Report' (CAND-00032) does not capture the stakeholder request to provide aggregated counts and grouping by title (to detect titles repeatedly lost or damaged). The emails explicitly state auditing needs ('showing how many items went missing/were damaged') and collection-decision needs ('if we keep losing the same titles...').
issue.suggested_fix: Extend CAND-00032 to require per-title (bibliographic-level) grouping and counts, and a mechanism to flag or rank titles with repeated losses/damage over a chosen time range to support collection decisions.

reason: Missing/damaged reporting must include aggregated counts and title-level grouping for auditing and collection decisions; current candidate lacks per-title aggregation.

reason: Missing/damaged report must expose and allow filtering by item status values (missing/lost/long-overdue) as described in multiple sources; add explicit status filtering and status display.

reason: In-transit detection logic was suggested by stakeholders (arrival null + departure > X days); document this detection approach or require configurable detection rules to avoid ambiguity.

issue.description: The existing candidate CAND-00058 (Report on Inactive Patrons) enumerates electronic activity as OPAC login, online hold placement and online renewals but omits explicit inclusion of digital-resource access. The omission changes the measurable definition of 'electronic activity' and could cause the report to miss patrons who only access digital resources.
issue.suggested_fix: Update CAND-00058 to include 'accessing digital collections (if integrated)' in the list of electronic activities. For example, extend the statement to: 'Electronic activity includes OPAC login, online hold placement, online renewals, and accessing digital collections (if integrated).' Use the original wording as guidance: '"Electronic activity" should include: ... 4. Accessing digital collections (if integrated)'.

reason: Inactive-patron 'electronic activity' definition must include digital-resource access where integrated (source explicitly listed this); update CAND-00058 to include it.

issue.description: The existing candidate CAND-00065 (Background Processing for Performance) records that the report should be handled as a background process, but its candidate statement omits the source's additional performance recommendation to cache results. issue.suggested_fix: Amend CAND-00065 to reference result caching as an expected optimization. For example: 'The report generation should be handled as a background process to ensure system performance; for very large patron sets the implementation should support caching of report results or intermediate query results to avoid repeated expensive queries.' Use the original phrasing as guidance: 'We should run it as a background report and cache results.'

reason: Background processing candidate (CAND-00065) should preserve the source recommendation to cache results for very large patron sets; add caching as an expected optimization.
